tei:div.tei:p: (ba)༄༅// dran pa gso thabs bzhugs// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ gang gi bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs pas// skyon rnams rgyu dang bcas pa ring spangs shing*// yon tan thams cad yongs su rdzogs gyur pa// 'gro ba'i bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi drin gyis lta ba'i 'ching ba kun// rnam par bkrol nas bde chen lam ston cing*// srid dang zhi ba 'jigs pa kun skyob pa// 'dren mchog bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal ba'i gsung rab legs tshogs rgya mtsho las// legs pa'i man ngag nor bu rin chen tshogs// bshes gnyen mchog gis bdag la legs gnang ba'i// tshul 'di rang gis dran bzhin bri bar bya// srid pa'i 'di ni sdug bsngal rgya mtsho ste// nyon mongs chu srin tshogs kyis rab tu gang*// skye rga na 'chi'i rba rlabs rab tu 'khrugs// 'di la thog ma med cing tha ma med// mtha' dang dbus med zad med 'phel ba med// de 'dra'i rgya mtshor thog med dus nas 'khyams// da dung du yang de rgyun ma bzlog na// phyi ma'i mur thug med par 'khyams gyur pas// 'di rgyud gcad pa'i phyir na brtson par bya// ston pa sred pa'i 'chings las ma grol zhing*// bstan pa srid pa'i rgyu dang mi 'gal la// bshes gnyen 'jig rten phun tshogs don gnyer ba// de lta'i rjes zhugs de las rab 'das kyang*// dmus long grogs bral rgya mtshor 'jug dang mtshungs// ston pa gang zhig skyon bral yon tan rdzogs// bstan pa bdag lta'i gnyen po nyid gyur la// bshes gnyen nges 'byung lam la rab mkhas pa// de dag la brten srid las brgal 'dod gang*// ded dpon mchog ldan gru chen nang zhugs nas// rgya mtsho las brgal rin chen gling zhugs te// yid bzhin nor bus bdag gzhan don grub mtshungs// ces pa 'di ni 'phags pas smras pa'o// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
